scientific_integrity: A complete analytic proof and executable reproducibility checks are supplied; computational experiments do not replace the theorem proof; original literature and earlier mathematical ingredients are acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Fixed odd polygon side count at least three; independent area-uniform points; no simultaneous side-count/sample-size limit
First-order small-tail formula is for the limiting random variable and is not a finite-sample identity
Unindexed earlier equivalent joint cone law remains a priority risk; the 2002 full text was unavailable
title: A coupled Poisson diameter law for odd regular polygons
